posts.title: Can AI be used safely?
posts.description: There are risks to using AI. But there is also an enormous amount of pressure to use AI. The message is, “USE IT FOR EVERYTHING OR YOU’RE A LUDDITE!!!!!” This is not a constructive message. Very few people want to slap AI into place without even giving a thought to whether it’s appropriate or effective. […]

posts.title: The Dawn of the LGTM (AI) Apocalypse
posts.description: Badly reviewed code has consequences. I've seen it bring down a site the moment it was deployed. And I've seen it get bogged down in QA because of unexpected handling of error cases. And I've seen it cause issues for users that QA, somehow, didn't catch.
